mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.review_id AS reviewId, r.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, r.content, r.from_merchant AS fromMerchant, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review_reply r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} AND r.audit_status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT id, review_id AS reviewId, user_id AS userId, reply_to_uid AS replyToUid, content, from_merchant AS fromMerchant, audit_status AS auditStatus, created_at AS createdAt FROM review_reply WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND from_merchant = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
